correctness.rationale: Exactly specified Clebsch Cayley graph; 352 nonempty faces. Unique containing neighborhood for each triangular-or-higher simplex reduces ranks ∂3=64 and ∂4=16 to simplex blocks; connected skeleton gives rank ∂1=15, and a reproducible independent 65-column rank calculation modulo two proves rational rank ∂2=65. Thus H2(Q) has dimension 31 and other positive rational homology vanishes. For every one of 1920 affine group elements, two separately implemented chain-trace formulas agree with a third induced-representation character. Fourier projectors give translation multiplicities 6/1/3 and stabilizer characters wedge^2standard, sign S3, and sign-twisted standard S4. The proof is exhaustive finite arithmetic and elementary representation theory, with no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The full action of the canonical 1920-element automorphism group on this historically important graph-coloring complex is a natural complete classification. It refines a previously known nonequivariant 31-sphere homotopy computation with an explicit 6+10+15 little-group splitting; its translation quotient retains six degree-two rational classes while the full orbit quotient has no positive rational homology. This distinction is meaningful for equivariant topology and cannot be inferred from Betti numbers alone.
